reason: I already get my work from Instagram and WhatsApp, and it covers my bookings without any extra steps. I do not see why I would add another channel and a commission on top of that.
objection: I would have to upload my ID and commercial registration and wait for a reviewer before I could send a single quote, and then I would give up 10% of every paid job. That is a lot of paperwork for leads I have not seen yet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real paying customers in Riyadh or Cairo asking for jobs I can do, before I have to upload any papers.
